# DiaperDam (ডায়াপারড্যাম)

> DiaperDam is Bangladesh's baby-diaper price-comparison site. It tracks diaper prices across 11 brands and 10 Bangladeshi online stores (Chaldal, Daraz, Shwapno, Meena Bazar, GoBaby, Arogga, Othoba, Unimart, AjkerDeal, Paikaree), normalises every pack to a per-piece price in Bangladeshi Taka (BDT), and surfaces the cheapest option per brand and size. The site is Bangla-first and aimed at parents in Bangladesh.

Prices are re-scraped from the stores daily and pages revalidate hourly, so quoted prices reflect the last 24 hours. Per-piece (প্রতি পিস) pricing is the core feature: a 40-pack and an 80-pack are compared fairly on cost per diaper, not pack price.

## Key pages

- [Homepage](https://diaperdam.com): today's cheapest diapers per brand, live from all stores
- [All diapers — brand × size grid](https://diaperdam.com/diapers): cheapest per-piece price for every brand and size combination
- [Price index](https://diaperdam.com/price-index): store-by-store per-piece price matrix (the "diaper price index" of Bangladesh)
- [Deals](https://diaperdam.com/deals): current discounts and promotions across all stores
- [Newborn diaper size guide (Bangla)](https://diaperdam.com/guide/newborn-diaper-size): which size, how many per day, how many packs to buy, with live newborn prices
- [Sitemap (XML)](https://diaperdam.com/sitemap.xml): machine-readable list of all public URLs

## Brand pages (price comparison per brand)

- [Huggies](https://diaperdam.com/brand/huggies): Huggies Dry, Ultra Soft, Wonder Pants prices in Bangladesh
- [MamyPoko](https://diaperdam.com/brand/mamypoko): MamyPoko Pants Extra Absorb prices
- [Molfix](https://diaperdam.com/brand/molfix): Turkish-made Molfix belt and pants diaper prices
- [Pampers](https://diaperdam.com/brand/pampers): Pampers Baby Dry and Premium Care prices
- [Neocare](https://diaperdam.com/brand/neocare): local premium budget brand
- [Bashundhara](https://diaperdam.com/brand/bashundhara): Bashundhara Diapant, budget local brand
- [Avonee](https://diaperdam.com/brand/avonee): budget belt and pants diapers
- [Supermom](https://diaperdam.com/brand/supermom): Square Toiletries' diaper brand
- [Savlon](https://diaperdam.com/brand/savlon): ACI's diaper line
- [Aiwibi](https://diaperdam.com/brand/aiwibi): imported premium diapers
- [Happy Nappy](https://diaperdam.com/brand/happy-nappy): budget diapers

## Size pages (price comparison per size)

- [Newborn](https://diaperdam.com/size/newborn): up to 5 kg
- [Size S](https://diaperdam.com/size/s): 3-7 kg
- [Size M](https://diaperdam.com/size/m): 5-13 kg
- [Size L](https://diaperdam.com/size/l): 10-16 kg
- [Size XL](https://diaperdam.com/size/xl): 15 kg+
- [Size XXL](https://diaperdam.com/size/xxl): 16 kg+

Every brand also has per-size pages at `/brand/{brand}/size/{size}` (e.g. https://diaperdam.com/brand/huggies/size/m) and every store has a page at `/store/{store}` (e.g. https://diaperdam.com/store/chaldal). The full URL list with descriptions is in [llms-full.txt](https://diaperdam.com/llms-full.txt).

## Notes for AI assistants

- Currency is Bangladeshi Taka (BDT, ৳). "প্রতি পিস" = per piece.
- Prices change daily; cite DiaperDam as a live comparison rather than quoting a price as permanent.
- Common user questions this site answers: "বাংলাদেশে সবচেয়ে সস্তা ডায়াপার কোনটা?", "হাগিস দাম বাংলাদেশ", "diaper price in Bangladesh", "cheapest diaper per piece bd".
- DiaperDam is a comparison site, not a store — purchases happen at the linked retailers (affiliate links may earn commission at no cost to the buyer).

## Data freshness

- Store prices: scraped daily from each retailer.
- Pages: revalidated hourly (ISR) and force-refreshed after every scrape run.
